description: Get requested tasks in caller ID order, report missing IDs and continue with a bounded cursor.

config.description: Program configuration path for slow_query_ms; otherwise OUTASK_CONFIG or the Outask default config.

limit.description: Integer limit from 1 to 50; default 10. For more paged results, use the returned continuation.

no_cache.description: Default false; omit for normal reads, which can use a freshness-checked cache when enabled and otherwise fall back to authoritative JSON. Set true only for explicit JSON-only reads or cache diagnostics; true never opens or refreshes the cache.

project_path.description: Project directory; defaults to server working directory.

schema_path.description: Project-relative task schema; overrides selection of tasks/task-schema.json.

stores.description: Store names; ["all"] includes retained history. Exclusive with group.

name: get_tasks
